Create a polished information design flowchart for a Chinese software-project handbook. One complete diagram, not a collage or a photo of a diagram. Use a refined editorial visual system: warm ivory canvas #F5F4EF, dark ink #19343D, generous margins, white cards with 1px pale gray outlines and softly rounded corners, precise thin orthogonal arrows and small arrowheads. A strong Chinese title at top-left, a small uppercase English section label above it, succinct Chinese body copy, short English technical labels only when needed. Teal #247B70 for current deterministic paths, blue #477A9F for input/output, muted purple #76659A for AI session/context, amber #B88635 for human review/conditional gates, muted coral #B75E56 for blocked/unverified, gray dashed panels for historical/experimental. Never use color alone: visibly label conditional and experimental boundaries. Flat vector-like editorial design suitable for faithfully recreating as editable SVG; no 3D, no glossy effects, no ornamental gear icons, no gradients, no stock art, no watermarks. Arrange all arrows clearly outside card text, no crossing through nodes. Prefer 2-3 rows with semantic swimlane labels, substantial whitespace, one prominent footer boundary strip. Fit every node with legible large Chinese text; each card has a short title and maximum 2 concise lines. Simplify supporting wording only; never omit gates or invent a completed state. Do not display filenames, local paths, secrets, URLs or code commits. The image is a visual design reference and will be reconstructed as native vector SVG. Use the following source-backed current content, and preserve main input/output and approval relationships. If this is the runtime sequence diagram, use 5 vertical lifelines and 8 chronological bands. If this is the historical cloud diagram, use a clearly visible HISTORICAL / 历史方案 badge and dashed gray connections.

节点：①同版本纯证道视频（待真实来源）；②直播归档 + 人工窗口（并行 fallback）；③冻结来源 / 英文 / 段落映射；④Astra Medium 中文口播审校；⑤已授权按讲员声音库；⑥Qwen3-TTS 生成可恢复候选；⑦原音对齐 / 中文时长装配；⑧内容、声音与同步审核；⑨完整每周发行包与 HTTP 核验；⑩同行 App 手动对齐 / 周日现场验收。

当前模型标签：口播 `gpt-6-astra / medium`；TTS `Qwen3-TTS 1.7B Base · 每讲员 checkpoint`；对齐 `Qwen3-ForcedAligner + FFmpeg`；回听 `Qwen3-ASR`。

TITLE: 输入到保存的时序（8 阶段节点）
建议维持时序图，泳道可为 Browser / Gateway / ASR / Translation / Disk，节点总数指 8 个时序阶段，而不是每条网络消息一个框。

节点：①Start 与 session/runtime identity；②双路 recording chunks + PCM；③VAD / ASR immutable final；④许可 context + 翻译；⑤Gateway 追加事件并下发 caption；⑥浏览器实际可读呈现反馈；⑦Stop / 上传完成 / 最新连接 drain；⑧Finalize WAV / hash / 原子 manifest。

关键箭头：Browser→Gateway start；Browser→Gateway→Disk recording/PCM 独立写入；Gateway→ASR→Gateway final；Gateway→Translation→Gateway tokens/final；Gateway→Disk+Browser；Browser→Gateway caption_rendered（不可观测另记）；Stop→drain→stream.closed latest epoch→finalize→Disk。

必须保留：模型结果经过 Gateway；raw append-only；独立音频不依赖推理成功；未确认 drain/storage 不报 completed；重连不保证字幕无损；手机没有逐条 render ACK，不能把操作页 render 时延当手机时延。
